meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键发布 npm 包到注册中心
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁地将 npm 包发布到线上。
copy.tagline_en: Publish npm packages to registry with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to publish npm packages.

howto.what: 装好后，你说要发布时，Claude 会走完整发布流程：先检查本地改动并同步代码，再触发自动发布，把新版本放到 npm 和 GitHub 上，然后写版本说明、发 Discord 公告。它只负责发布，不做代码审查（除非你明确要求）。
howto.when: 当你提到“发布”“部署”“npm publish”等触发词，并指定版本升级类型（patch/minor/major）时触发；未指定升级类型会先停下询问，确认后才继续。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本。
say.note: 自动触发发布流程并验证 npm 与 GitHub 产物。

say.text: 帮我发一个 minor 版本，记得写发布摘要。
执行 npm publish，升级到 major。
say.note: 版本升级为 major，自动运行完整发布流程。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the oh-my-opencode npm release pipeline end-to-end: triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, verifies release artifacts, drafts a release summary, announces on Discord. It skips code review unless explicitly asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'publish'/'release'/'deploy'/'npm publish' requests. Requires a bump type (patch/minor/major); if missing, Claude asks.

say_en.note: Runs the publish flow and verifies npm/GitHub outputs.

say_en.text: Ship a minor release and include a release summary.
say_en.note: Drafts the summary, applies it, posts to Discord.

say_en.text: Run npm publish with a major bump.
say_en.note: Major bump: triggers the full release workflow.
